tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Enterprise brand plum ($o-brand-odoo). Primary buttons (btn-primary), the active app tile, the cover. White text on it (7.4:1).

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover / pressed state of btn-primary.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Action teal ($o-action). Links, many2one values, the active statusbar step, focused field underline, selected checkbox. Reads 4.9:1 on view-bg.

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of links and action-coloured text.

tokens.name: action-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of the current statusbar step and selected list rows; action text on it.

tokens.name: gray-100
tokens.usage: Webclient background behind form sheets; control panel ground; list row hover.

tokens.name: gray-200
tokens.usage: btn-secondary fill; list and table hairlines; statusbar inactive steps.

tokens.name: gray-300
tokens.usage: Field underlines, input borders, sheet border, card border.

tokens.name: gray-400
tokens.usage: Disabled text and icons only (not body text: 2.7:1).

tokens.name: gray-500
tokens.usage: Placeholders, inactive icons, search-icon. 3.9:1 — never body text.

tokens.name: gray-600
tokens.usage: Muted text: field labels in lists, help text, breadcrumb parents, list footers. 6.1:1 on view-bg.

tokens.name: gray-700
tokens.usage: Main text colour of the web client ($o-main-text-color) on view-bg and gray-100.

tokens.name: gray-800
tokens.usage: Headings, record titles, breadcrumb current item.

tokens.name: gray-900
tokens.usage: Strongest text: amounts in totals rows, text on btn-secondary.

tokens.name: view-bg
tokens.usage: Form sheet, list table, kanban card and dialog surface.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body text on view-bg and gray-100.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on view-bg and gray-100.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Default 1px border for sheets, cards, inputs.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Row separators in list views and tables.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success fill (posted dot, positive bar). As text on white only at 24px+ (3.1:1); use success-ink for small text.

tokens.name: success-subtle
tokens.usage: Ground of the success badge (Posted, Balanced).

tokens.name: success-ink
tokens.usage: Text on success-subtle (7.9:1) and receipt amounts on view-bg.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Info fill (alert icon, chart bars).

tokens.name: info-subtle
tokens.usage: Ground of the info badge and info alerts (Draft).

tokens.name: info-ink
tokens.usage: Text on info-subtle (7.8:1).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning fill and icon. Never text on white (1.9:1); dark text on it.

tokens.name: warning-subtle
tokens.usage: Ground of the warning badge and warning alert (cash difference).

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Text on warning-subtle (5.5:1).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Danger fill, required-field error underline, delete icon. As small text it reads 4.2:1 on white — use danger-ink.

tokens.name: danger-subtle
tokens.usage: Ground of the danger badge and invalid field (Cancelled, Short).

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Text on danger-subtle and payment amounts on view-bg (6.2:1 on white).

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Ubuntu, "Noto Sans", Arial, sans-serif
families.mono: SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace

styles.name: record-title
styles.usage: The h1 name of a record on a form sheet.

styles.name: breadcrumb
styles.usage: Current breadcrumb item in the control panel.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: o_horizontal_separator / group titles inside a sheet; kanban card titles.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Field values, list cells, menus. The base size of the web client.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels in form groups; list column headers.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Help text, badges, chatter timestamps, kanban secondary lines.

styles.name: kpi
styles.usage: Balances on dashboard cards and the day-close summary.

tokens.name: space-1

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons; list cell padding-x; field padding-y.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control panel padding-y; kanban card inner gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: o-horizontal-padding: control panel and list padding-x; card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between form groups; dashboard card grid gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Form sheet inner padding-x on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Kanban/dashboard cards, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges (rounded-pill), search facets.

tokens.usage: Form sheet and kanban card resting lift.

tokens.name: shadow-dropdown
tokens.usage: Dropdown menus, autocomplete, dialogs.
